sentences.en: She studied meteorology at university and now works as a weather forecaster.
sentences.zh: 她在大学学习了气象学，现在是一名天气预报员。

sentences.en: The course covers topics like climate change and meteorology.
sentences.zh: 这门课程包括气候变迁和气象学等相关话题。

sentences.en: Every day, we check the online meteorology reports to plan our outdoor activities.
sentences.zh: 为了计划户外活动，我们每天都会查看网上发布的气象报告。
